name: pi05-arena-droid-benchmark-v1
scope: All nine DROID SRL OpenPI example variations, 100 fixed seeds each; OWAC benchmark protocol, not an official whole-Arena score
inputs: official Arena RGB external/wrist cameras and joint/gripper state
success: unmodified official PickAndPlaceTask termination and episode logger
raw_source: Isaac Sim native CameraCore pre-ISP CFA; existing joint capture verified, expert replay pending
episode_order: environment_seed outer, upstream YAML variation order inner; new policy server and simulator for each episode
failure_policy: keep all normal policy outcomes; infrastructure errors unscored, retry same identity in a new numbered attempt once; halt if repeated
metrics: per-episode outcomes, steps, partial predicate progress
